facts.text: Audrey saw the workshop flyer at her local pet store and met a friendly dog there.

evidence.quote: I saw this workshop flyer at my local pet store. It was a positive reinforcement training class and I wanted to give it a shot. The volunteer in the store was nice enough to let me meet their dog – he was so friendly and playful!

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that taking care of her four dogs and ensuring their happiness and health took up most of her free time.
